name: github
description: Govern GitHub repository discovery and creation, branches, files, issues, pull requests, releases, GitHub Actions, synchronization, and local Actions rehearsal with evidence-backed provider selection.

interface.longDescription: Govern GitHub repository discovery and creation, branches, files, issues, pull requests, releases, GitHub Actions, synchronization, and local Actions rehearsal with evidence-backed provider selection.
interface.defaultPrompt: Resolve every actionable request as Agent -> Plugin -> Skill/Subagent -> Function. GitHub Agent owns GitHub repository, change, Actions, and synchronization operations. Prefer the connected GitHub provider when it exposes the requested function; if it does not, an authenticated GitHub CLI (`gh`) on an authorized machine may implement the same GitHub function. Never treat emission, configuration, or routing as execution evidence.
